items.title: I drove Tesla FSD, Rivian Autonomy+ ‘hands-free’ driving systems. Here’s how they compare
items.description: Rivian is trying to catch up to Tesla's "hands-free" capabilities, but with additional safety guardrails that the Elon Musk company doesn't have.

items.title: How long will software-defined cars last? The auto industry doesn't know yet
items.description: Cars that run on software offer benefits automakers and many customers say older cars cannot compete with. But some analysts worry the vehicles might not last.

items.title: Iran rebuffs Trump's claim over Strait of Hormuz amid report of another ship being struck
items.description: Iran's deputy foreign minister says Hormuz "will remain Iranian" after Trump's claim that the waterway would soon become U.S. territory.

items.title: Beijing is said to move to clarify tax rules stoking confusion among China's ultra-wealthy
items.description: Beijing is said to be moving to clarify ambiguities in new tax rules on offshore trusts after the policy sowed confusion among wealthy Chinese and advisors.

items.title: Extreme heat spurs earliest-ever Champagne harvest, putting its famous taste to the test
items.description: Producers of the iconic French fizz face a challenge to preserve its taste profile while they also battle tariff complications and fewer drinkers.

items.title: Russia's economy has defied the skeptics. Cracks are getting harder to hide
items.description: Russia's wartime economy is under growing strain as its budget deficit widens and analysts warn pressure could intensify next year.

items.title: Trump family-backed crypto firm World Liberty gets conditional bank charter approval
items.description: The OCC conditionally approved World Liberty Trust Co.’s national trust bank charter. That would allow the Trump family-backed firm to issue stablecoins.

items.title: Nvidia discloses $21 billion stake in SpaceX at end of second quarter
items.description: Nvidia's stake in SpaceX, which came through an investment in xAI, was worth about $21 billion at the end of the second quarter.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway boosts Alphabet to a top three holding, ups Delta and housing bets
items.description: Berkshire owned about 106 million shares in the parent of Google, worth $37.9 billion at the end of June, according to a regulatory filing released Friday.

items.title: Goldman’s latest cash cow is all about funding the AI infrastructure boom
items.description: Nvidia and Intel recently tapped the bank to help them meeting soaring demand for compute.

items.title: Drone stocks rally after Trump orders tariffs on foreign-made components
items.description: The U.S. is looking to scale defense manufacturing and chip away at China's drone dominance.

items.title: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty in federal case related to UnitedHealthcare CEO killing
items.description: Mangione's lawyers argue his federal plea bars his prosecution for murder in state court for Brian Thompson's slaying due to New York's double jeopardy law

items.title: Regulators and banks step up scrutiny of prediction markets
items.description: The CFTC is reviewing prediction betting platforms' so-called mention markets, people familiar with the matter confirmed to CNBC.

items.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to let White House ballroom construction continue
items.description: President Donald Trump tore down the White House East Wing to make way for the ballroom project.

items.title: OpenAI talent exodus raises 'huge red flag' ahead of IPO
items.description: OpenAI's C-suite turnover gives investors another reason for concern as the company pushes toward a mammoth IPO.

items.title: 10-year Treasury yield inches higher as traders digest soft retail sales, monitor the Middle East
items.description: The moves come after the latest retail sales figures missed expectations and the U.S. said its naval blockade of Iranian ports could continue "indefinitely."

items.title: Lamborghini unveils Revuelto SV, its most powerful production car ever
items.description: Lamborghini's Revuelto SV is a limited-edition V12 hybrid with over 1,050 horsepower, a 2.4-second 0-to-100 kph time and a $741,172 starting price.

items.title: Group including Jeff Bezos buys minority stake in Liverpool FC, with option to become controlling owner
items.description: The group that includes Jeff Bezos has an option to become the majority shareholder within the next year.

items.title: Disney CEO Josh D'Amaro tells CNBC parks were 'big surprise' in last quarter, company has 'clarity' and 'stability'
items.description: New CEO Josh D'Amaro has said his strategy for continued growth at Disney is centered around storytelling, intellectual property and technology.

items.title: Court rules companies can't import Gilead medications from overseas in blow to AFP health programs
items.description: A U.S. appeals court has ruled in favor of Gilead Sciences against companies known as alternative funding programs that import medicines from overseas.
